-- Comprehensive Data Quality Report for Weather Data

-- 1. DUPLICATE DETECTION
WITH daily_duplicates AS (
    SELECT 
        location_id,
        date,
        COUNT(*) as duplicate_count
    FROM daily_weather
    GROUP BY location_id, date
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
hourly_duplicates AS (
    SELECT 
        location_id,
        datetime,
        COUNT(*) as duplicate_count
    FROM hourly_weather
    GROUP BY location_id, datetime
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
    'DUPLICATE DETECTION' as report_section,
    'daily_weather' as table_name,
    COUNT(*) as duplicate_groups,
    SUM(duplicate_count - 1) as total_duplicate_records
FROM daily_duplicates
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'DUPLICATE DETECTION' as report_section,
    'hourly_weather' as table_name,
    COUNT(*) as duplicate_groups,
    SUM(duplicate_count - 1) as total_duplicate_records
FROM hourly_duplicates;

-- 2. NULL VALUE ANALYSIS - Daily Weather
WITH daily_totals AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_records FROM daily_weather
),
daily_nulls AS (
    SELECT 
        'max_temp_c' as column_name,
        COUNT(*) as null_count
    FROM daily_weather
    WHERE max_temp_c IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'min_temp_c' as column_name,
        COUNT(*) as null_count
    FROM daily_weather
    WHERE min_temp_c IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'avg_temp_c' as column_name,
        COUNT(*) as null_count
    FROM daily_weather
    WHERE avg_temp_c IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'avg_humidity' as column_name,
        COUNT(*) as null_count
    FROM daily_weather
    WHERE avg_humidity IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'total_precip_mm' as column_name,
        COUNT(*) as null_count
    FROM daily_weather
    WHERE total_precip_mm IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'total_snow_cm' as column_name,
        COUNT(*) as null_count
    FROM daily_weather
    WHERE total_snow_cm IS NULL
)
SELECT 
    'NULL VALUE ANALYSIS' as report_section,
    'daily_weather' as table_name,
    dn.column_name,
    dn.null_count,
    dt.total_records,
    ROUND(100.0 * dn.null_count / NULLIF(dt.total_records, 0), 2) as null_percentage
FROM daily_nulls dn
CROSS JOIN daily_totals dt
WHERE dn.null_count > 0
ORDER BY dn.null_count DESC;
